profileBriefs.description: Indonesian multimodal mobility operator with Bluebird, Silverbird and Prime tiers, its own booking app and delivery services.
profileBriefs.ownershipFact: PT Blue Bird Tbk, IDX ticker BIRD; do not confuse with the US school-bus issuer.
profileBriefs.businessModel: Fleet-based mobility with multiple service and payment channels.
profileBriefs.whyWatch: Direct local mobility competition and distribution partnerships create both competitive and commercial relevance.
profileBriefs.strategicQuestion: Can differentiated service standards and digital booking produce profitable repeat rides?

keyFacts.label: Prime launch
keyFacts.value: Hybrid / EV tier; five named cities

countryFacts.fact: Prime launch release names Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Medan and Bali. This is the product launch footprint, not every group operating location.

profileBriefs.description: Alfamart-linked virtual storefront for resellers, with catalogue access and coaching; a separate product from Alfagift.
profileBriefs.ownershipFact: Official terms identify PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk working with partners as the service organiser; the app listing identifies Mindstores as developer.
profileBriefs.businessModel: Agents market products and place orders through a digital storefront. Official materials promote selling without agent-held inventory or shipping.
profileBriefs.whyWatch: A local model for assisted commerce and merchant acquisition through trusted networks.
profileBriefs.strategicQuestion: Does agent distribution generate incremental demand after commissions, fulfilment and support costs?

keyFacts.label: Agent cash requirement
keyFacts.value: Help centre describes a transaction deposit that cannot be withdrawn; no-capital marketing is not proof of zero working capital.

caseStudies.title: GoCar: validate a premium tier through service consistency
caseStudies.facts: Bluebird launched a hybrid / EV Prime tier with explicit vehicle standards and multiple booking channels.
caseStudies.gotoLesson: Define the service promise before scaling a premium product.
caseStudies.indonesiaTransferability: Direct local comparison; partner fleets, driver economics and demand may differ.
caseStudies.proposedPilot: Run a limited-area test with a comparable rider holdout before expanding supply.
caseStudies.limitations: The launch announcement does not prove profitable adoption. This is an analyst experiment.
caseStudies.status: Primary facts reviewed; GoTo experiment is a hypothesis

caseStudies.title: Alfamind: test agent-led commerce beyond the consumer app
caseStudies.facts: Alfamind combines virtual-store agents, a retail catalogue and sales coaching. Its help centre describes a non-withdrawable transaction deposit.
caseStudies.gotoLesson: Evaluate assisted merchant distribution as an acquisition channel with explicit cash and service requirements.
caseStudies.indonesiaTransferability: Local analogue for GoPay merchant distribution and GoMart demand aggregation; a GoTo partnership is not established.
caseStudies.proposedPilot: Pilot an opt-in agent cohort against a matched acquisition channel, with clear refund and settlement rules.
caseStudies.limitations: Official marketing does not establish active-agent scale, realised margins or profitability. No current GoTo integration is inferred.
caseStudies.status: Primary operating facts reviewed; GoTo pilot is analyst interpretation
